notes.title: A New Chapter Opens: New Languages, Allies, and Adventures!
notes.content:
Brave adventurers of Erondàr,
The battle against Draquir spreads beyond borders—and so must the call to heroes. We’re proud to unveil a major update that brings Dragonero – The Rise of Draquir to even more warriors around the world!
[h2]New Languages Available[/h2]
Thanks to the invaluable support of our allies, we’ve expanded the reach of our world:
[list]
[*]Simplified and Traditional Chinese are now fully available! This has been made possible through our collaboration with [b]2P Games[/b], bringing the world of Erondàr to a whole new legion of adventurers.
[*]French localization has been added! Bonjour to our new companions ready to join the resistance.
[*]Japanese translation revised and updated with the expert work of [b]智犬 (TomoInu)[/b] and [b]Rokusai Katsushika[/b]—thank you for your dedication and passion!
 [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/7c4c9205a79661a3731877d9b08cf5e97d57363d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Turn-Based Thursday Fest[/h2]
We’re thrilled to announce our participation in the [b]#TurnBasedThursdayFest[/b]! If you're a fan of tactical thinking, calculated moves, and the thrill of classic RPG combat—this is your moment. Join us in celebrating the genre that defines Dragonero's core!
[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
As always, we've squashed some bugs lurking in the shadows of Erondàr and made a number of quality-of-life improvements thanks to your continued feedback.

Erondàr grows stronger with every hero who joins the cause. Whether you're returning to the field or just beginning your journey, we thank you for walking this path with us.

🛡️ The Dragonero Dev Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.10 - A new dungeon experience
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/9cb17a0c1450611f96e3a5dfed98ff728f35503a.gif[/img]

We are happy to share with you a new update dedicated specifically to making the gameplay experience even more immersive and engaging. We have been working on visual and gameplay elements, as well as fixing some bugs reported by the community (thank you all for the support!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/f01cab045491f2d6d8383372148462d66043bbc2.gif[/img]

[h3]What's new[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added new modular scenes in dungeons: now exploration is more varied and immersive thanks to novel combinations.
[*]Introduced visible walls inside dungeon rooms, improving readability and allowing more articulated tactical patterns.
[*]Updated the confirmation sound in menus to make it clearer and less intrusive. (Thanks to user @Stubbieoz for feedback!)
[*]Improved the variety of random encounters in dungeons with new enemy types and layouts.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/540be6d17f655cb64acee9562d2e9ef8e9c462ea.gif[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented entry into the volcano dungeon under certain circumstances. (Thanks to user @tomoinu for the report!)
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed skills to be used on party members during the final bossfight. (Thanks again to @tomoinu!)
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented proper equipping of accessories on some characters. (@tomoinu MVP!)
[*]Fixed the dungeon preview panel in town, which now shows the correct information.
[*]Fixed the ship icon that kept being visible even after landing on land.
[*]Minor fixes to tooltips and descriptions of some skills that had incorrect or incomplete text.
[*]General optimizations to client stability in some areas with high density of visual effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: Steam Cloud, Steam Deck Support, and More
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/0d07f8067109bf3d4367b8cba89e9851eb89a3dc.png[/img]

Greetings, heroes of Dragonero!

We’re thrilled to announce that a brand-new update for Dragonero – The Rise of Draquir has just gone live! This update is packed with improvements to make your adventure through the Lands of Erondàr smoother, more accessible, and even more engaging. Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or a newly recruited hero, there’s something here for everyone. Let’s dive into the details!

[h2]Steam Cloud Support: Your Save Games, Wherever You Go[/h2]

With Steam Cloud support now fully implemented, your progress will be safely stored and ready to pick up no matter which device you’re playing on. Whether you’re at home or on the go, your adventures will always be by your side. No dragon left unconquered, no treasure unclaimed!

[h2]Optimized for Steam Deck: Erondàr Bliss in Your Hands[/h2]

Are you one of the lucky warriors battling the forces of Draquir on Steam Deck? Good news! We’ve upgraded the user interface to ensure that navigating the game on Steam Deck feels as natural as wielding a blade. From redesigned menus to more intuitive controls, your portable Dragonero experience has never been better.

[h2]Enhanced Game Balance[/h2]

We’ve listened to your feedback, studied your strategies, and fine-tuned the game’s balance to make every battle even more rewarding. Enemies will pose a fairer challenge, your party’s abilities will shine brighter, and the tactical depth you love will keep you on your toes. It’s time to rethink your tactics!

[h2]Pause Menu & Exit Game Option[/h2]

With this update, we’ve added a pause menu and a dedicated exit game option. Whether you’re pausing to plan your next move or stepping away to regroup in real life, you’ll have the control you need right at your fingertips. Just press "P".

[h2]Join the Conversation[/h2]

Your adventures and feedback inspire us to make Dragonero – The Rise of Draquir the best it can be. Share your thoughts on these updates and let us know what you’d like to see next. Head over to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2532770/discussions/]Community Hub[/url] and let’s keep the conversation going!

Thank you for embarking on this journey with us. The Lands of Erondàr are filled with challenges, mysteries, and tales yet to unfold, and we can’t wait to see how your legend grows. So, gear up, strategize, and march onward—Draquir awaits!

Until next time, adventurers…

The Dragonero Development Team

notes.content:

First of all, we want to thank you for your support and passion for Dragonero, our first project.

The week after the release was intense and, after a short rest, we started working again with the very useful feedback you sent us. Any feedback is helpful and we are collecting them to better plan the next patches, starting with improving the UI and readability of interfaces and text. We will make a roadmap public in the coming weeks.

We are determined to improve Dragonero and make it the best game possible in the coming months, with continued support and updates. 

An initial update is available as of today.

notes.title: Master Mode
notes.content:
Master Mode allows you to play Dragonero in the role of Master, as we understand it when playing RPGs such as Dungeons & Dragons: creating your own adventure and placing it persistently in the game world, making it playable by other players with the ability to share stories and challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/7efa5e66b377ae1b68cc4eab8f398557747b4092.gif[/img]

You will be able to build the layout of your dungeon, write the story, and choose from a multitude of custom enemies. Master Mode will allow you to:
[list]
[*] create adventures from scratch, leveraging assets and setting
[*] place your adventures in the game world.
[*] share adventures and challenges with other players.
[/list]

Master Mode consists of three tools: [b]Dungeon Wizard[/b], [b]Creature Wizard[/b]and [b]Quest Wizard[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/6ef7e3417cda1e8a094e41b9715d91abb6adfcb3.gif[/img]

[h2]Dungeon Wizard[/h2].
With the Dungeon Wizard, it is possible to create a dungeon at a specific location on the map. Whether it's to create a new and exciting challenge or to bring an epic quest to life, you can customize every aspect of it.

In this mode you can:
[list]
[*] choose the depth of the dungeon, choosing how many rooms it will have.
[*] customize each room
[*] insert dozens of different enemies and battle formations, including custom creatures in the Creature Wizard
[*] choose rewards and obstacles for your players
[/list]

As you build the dungeon you will see its [b]Challenge Value[/b], which determines how deadly it will be for players.
The dungeon's biome will be defined by the part of the world in which it is created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/413b5ea38a97b2d25d9138d7b77d5ba6fa1f1d11.gif[/img]

[h2]Creature Wizard[/h2].
Select a race of the Erondàr and customize it as you like. With the Creature Wizard editor you can modify every parameter, skill and even battle formations.

In this mode you can:
[list]
[*] Select the name, description and appearance of your creature.
[*] select its threat level
[*] customize statistics and resistant
[*] equip skills and define battle style
[*] build formations composed of custom and classic creatures
[/list]

Find the right balance and bring the characters of your imagination to life, breathing life into them and releasing them into the Dragonero universe.


[h2]Quest Wizard[/h2].
In the Quest Wizard you can link all your creations: dungeons, characters, and creatures that will bring the epic adventures you create to life.

In this mode you can:
[list]
[*] choose which city or part of the world to start the quest in.
[*] build each phase of the quest
[*] customize each phase by choosing what actions the player must take.
[/list]

The Quest Wizard allows you to start an entire adventure made up of quests and explorations that will bring other players into your vision within the world of Dragonero.

Creating a new adventure in the world of Erondár is simple and we are sure it will give you great satisfaction. Sharing of created content will be done directly through [b]Steamworks [/b]and we hope to see as many stories as possible set in the wonderful world of Dragonero.

It will be possible to try out the Master Mode at the Festival RPG Direct on July 27.

Are you ready for this epic journey? Follow Dragonero and put the game on your wishlist so you don't miss the news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2532770/

[i]Khame adwerte nàu oméa![/i]

notes.title: Dev Logbook: Game Overview
notes.content:
Welcome new Imperial Scouts!

Good news comes from the realm of Erondár, with an overview that will touch on the various features of Dragonero: Rise of Draquir and the new update.
Here are the topics in brief:
[list]
[*] New update: new features and revisions.
[*] Dungeons: now NPCs will appear inside them
[*] Camp: make heroes rest as best as possible
[*] Improvements to cities
[*] Master Mode: the world of Dragonero is in your hands
[/list]
[h2]The near future, new update[/h2]

The development team is working on an overhaul of the user experience and implementation of the mouse, selecting skills or various locations in the empire will be easier than ever. Hunger has been rebalanced to make it less tedious in movement.
Fonts for dialogue and titles have been changed. The opening cutscene has been removed and its narrative content will now be narrated throughout the game.

[h2]New encounters in dangerous places[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/47be941e827c62faae1e5e2d3b34f50094270504.gif[/img]

Dungeons are one of the main stages of the game, ready to test your skill in confrontations and resource management. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/b0edc0c6b4b53b94a92692568fa64d6f64a41de9.gif[/img]

In addition to facing enemies and finding treasures from now they will also be populated by NPCs. Are you ready to discover the new surprises that await you as you explore?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/654335ac9692531f89f2e4ea1f13384b8ffcef81.gif[/img]

[h2]Even heroes need rest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/6cb943dabbde129d9eb960e93151fec77f2c71fc.gif[/img]

Camp is a central moment in Dragonero gameplay and allows the heroes to recover from exploration.
Within it you will have numerous choices, it must be remembered that even at this time each party member has their own function and preferences (for example, Sera is a vegetarian). Therefore, the task best suited to them should be given to each of them.

[h2]A place for exchange and gathering[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/dd1565f5724c2ea53230140ac490ca6acfc35a1e.gif[/img]

Cities are a key stop on any hero's journey. Find new quests, visit stores and more. There is no limit to the events that can happen in these densely populated areas. From now on, it will also be easier to interact with the various city elements. The UI and text readability have also been improved.

[h2]Unleash your creativity with Master Mode[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730239/bbbde0b470aa6ef4d2cc7312d444040d71373f3c.gif[/img]

Master Mode is a game section that will be available in the full game. Are you ready to create your dungeon?
Create the layout of your dungeon, write the story and choose from a multitude of enemies.

The Master Mode is divided into three sections:
[list]
[*] Dungeon Wizard: you can choose the order of the rooms you prefer, the number and type of enemies as well as the rewards.
[*] Creature Wizard: create new characters and creatures for your adventures and dungeons.
[*] Quest Wizard: create your own adventures, use your imagination to create your own dungeon master work.
[/list]
Creating a new adventure in the world of Erondár is simple and we are sure it will give you great satisfaction.


Are you ready for this epic journey? Follow Dragonero and put the game on your wishlist so you don't miss out on what's new!

In the meantime, you can contact us on our discord server or in the Steam community hub, we will read every comment with interest.
